Dear Claims Representative:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the inujred party in connection
with the sideswipe collision that ocucrred while our client was changing lanes. Our
client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care for
them. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including
requests for statements, scheduling, and settlement discussions, exclusively to this
office. Our client should not be contacted directly by you or any representative of
your company.
We ask that you provide the policy limits for all coverages applicable to the at-fault
driver, along with a copy of the declarations page, so that we can evaluate the claim
properly. Please also confirm in writing the claim number assigned to this loss and the
name of the adjuster handling the file.
We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision.
This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle inspection reports,
recorded statements, claim notes, and any other mateirals in your possession. Please
suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such records while the claim is pending. We
look forward to your prompt written response.
Sincerely,
Brandon Barnes
Dunn & Acosta LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
